name: iam:AttachUserPolicy + iam:CreateAccessKey
description: Attach an administrative managed policy to a target user, then create access keys for that user to gain their elevated permissions. Requires both iam:AttachUserPolicy and iam:CreateAccessKey on the target user.
author: Seth Art

required.description: Must have access to attach policies to the target user
Must have permission to create access keys for the target user

admin: Target user must have fewer than 2 access keys (AWS limit)
An AWS-managed or customer-managed policy with admin permissions must exist
lateral: Target user must have fewer than 2 access keys (AWS limit)

references.title: AWS Privilege Escalation Methods and Mitigation

techniques: T1098.001 - Account Manipulation: Additional Cloud Credentials

options.name: POLICY_ARN
options.description: ARN of the managed policy to attach (defaults to AdministratorAccess)

options.name: AUTO_SWITCH
options.description: Automatically switch to new identity after successful key creation
